events.info: Doors: 6:30PM Show: 8PM *All times are subject to change Ages 3+ welcome. Everyone requires a ticket regardless of age. The balcony is only accessible by stairs. Following more than 100 acclaimed performances across North and South America, Europe, and Japan, BEAT returns this fall for the last North American tour. Former King Crimson members Adrian Belew and Tony Levin are joined by guitar virtuoso Steve Vai and legendary drummer Terry Bozzio to perform the music of the three landmark 1980s King Crimson albums - Discipline, Beat, and Three of a Perfect Pair. Rather than attempting to recreate the original recordings, BEAT brings this extraordinary music to life with the spirit, precision, and adventurousness that made it so enduring. Whether you've lived with these albums for decades or are discovering them for the first time, this is the final opportunity to experience one of progressive music's most celebrated catalogs performed by four of the best musicians on the planet

World Ballet Company: The Sleeping Beauty An Ultimate Fairy Tale for the whole family! Experience the enchanting world of The Sleeping Beauty in a breathtaking new production from World Ballet Company. This magical performance features forty professional dancers, over 150 radiant costumes, stunning hand-crafted sets and multimedia effects. Follow Princess Aurora from her joyful christening to the wicked fairy Carabosse's powerful curse, the kingdom's enchanted hundred-year sleep, and the magical kiss that awakens the sleeping beauty. From the iconic Rose Adagio to the grand wedding celebration, every moment is filled with beauty and wonder. Share an unforgettable evening where fairy tales come to life, love conquers darkness, and happily ever after awaits.
